explanation:
Most keys: Tenali. NextGen's previous-papers list (Part 7 p.27) gives Bapatla, whose station was also attacked in August 1942.

q: Who was the first commander-in chief of the Indian National Army?
explanation: Captain Mohan Singh raised the first INA (1942) and was its first commander; Subhas Bose became Supreme Commander only in August 1943.

notes.text: - **Idea and founder:** the idea of an army of Indian POWs was **Captain Mohan Singh's** (Spectrum); he is the **founder and first commander** of the INA (Azad Hind Fauj) – not Subhas Bose, who took over only in 1943.

q: The Azad Hind Fauz was Started at:
explanation: The Azad Hind Fauj was started at Singapore (by Mohan Singh in 1942, reorganised there by Bose in 1943).

notes.text: - **Where and when:** formed in **Singapore** (then British Malaya) in **February 1942**, after the **fall of Singapore**; ~40,000 volunteers by end-1942; first division of **16,300** men formally raised **1 September 1942**.
- **"INA set up / started in 1943"** questions → **Singapore** (where Bose reorganised it); "head office" → **Rangoon**.
